text:
Sanjay: Heads up — 3 nodes in aps1b gpu pool just started power-cycling, looks like PMBus/regulator flapping. Seeing spike in pod evictions and 503s.

Maya: which racks? any pattern with rack/u?

Sanjay: racks r12-14 in aps1b, all Ampere A100 80GB. Node IDs gpu-aps1b-r12-07, -08, -09.

Leo: oncall @Ryan — can you confirm hardware? I'm seeing nvlink resets + PMBus events in metrics.

Ryan: I'm on it. Pulling dmesg and i2c logs, will SSH into gpu-aps1b-r12-07 now.

OpsBot: Alert: node gpu-aps1b-r12-07 transitioned to POWER_FAIL at 2026-02-14T09:03:12Z

Ryan: confirmed kernel shows "PMBus: regulator 0 undervoltage, restarting" and fans spike to 100% then node reboots.

Maya: plan: cordon + drain those 3 nodes, shift capacity to eu-west-1 and us-west-2 for the next 2 hrs. Eng-sre: please run drains and adjust autoscaler.

Adriana: tagging hw-team for swap: @hw-dispatch — need 3 replacement power regulator modules, priority high. Do we have spares in-region?

Tom (hw-dispatch): We have 2 spare regulator boards in ap-southeast stock. Ordering third overnight from vendor, ETA ~9h.

Leo: quick drain commands to run (graceful eviction):
```
kubectl cordon gpu-aps1b-r12-07
kubectl drain gpu-aps1b-r12-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
kubectl cordon gpu-aps1b-r12-08
kubectl drain gpu-aps1b-r12-08 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
```
Running -07 now.

Maya: routing change — enabling cross-region overflow policy: GPU_OVERFLOW -> [us-west-2, eu-west-1]. Also lowering route concurrency cap to 4 for impacted model routes to avoid tail latency.

Sanjay: starting controlled traffic shift now, monitoring p50/p95/p99 and token throughput.

Ryan: performed drain on -07 and -08; -09 draining in progress. Evictions completed, autoscaler spawned replacements in us-west. No data-plane 5xx after shift so far.

OpsBot: Change: route-policy GPU_OVERFLOW toggled at 2026-02-14T09:21:45Z by Maya

Adriana: creating incident ticket INC-20260214-77, assigning to HW + Infra. Will track spare procurement and vendor dispatch.

Maya: cost note — cross-region overflow will incur egress + instance cost; rough estimate extra ~$1.8k per 24h at current qps. Need approval to proceed. @Finance

Finance: approved emergency routing charges. Proceed.

Ryan: nodes will be powered off and held in rack until swap. Scheduling vendor tech for on-site replacement and burn-in.

Tom (hw-dispatch): Vendor slot booked: tech arrives 2026-02-15 03:00 UTC. Replacing regulator modules and running 6h burn-in.

Maya: after swap we'll uncordon and run soak tests (small traffic ramp + perf checks) before rejoining pool.

Sanjay: dashboards look stable after traffic shift; p99 latency improved and error rate back to baseline. Closing immediate action loop. Will update on hardware replacement status.

Adriana: assigning postmortem owner @Maya. Please capture root cause, alerting on PMBus flaps, and spare policy (recommend 3 spares per region).

Maya: will open postmortem doc and ping team. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
